name: local-chrome-devtools-axi
description: Vendored copy of chrome-devtools-axi (AXI browser-automation CLI). Own code clean — no telemetry. Runtime mcp pinned. See ../AUDIT.md.

patches: bridge.js: runtime spawn pinned chrome-devtools-mcp@latest -> @1.4.0 (no floating browser download)
deps: axi-sdk-js + @toon-format/toon repointed to local; @modelcontextprotocol/sdk pinned exact
notes: RUNTIME: spawns `npx chrome-devtools-mcp@1.4.0` (pulls Chromium) on first browser command. Set CHROME_DEVTOOLS_AXI_BROWSER_URL to attach to system Chrome and avoid any download.
`setup hooks` writes ~/.claude / ~/.codex via axi-sdk-js — opt-in, never automatic.
